restaurant: Saravanaa Bhavan South Indian Pure Vegetarian

items.name: Special Masala Dosa
items.description: Crispy fermented rice and black lentil crepe filled with spiced potato masala, served with sambar and fresh coconut chutneys.
items.allergen_notes: Tempered with black mustard seeds and ghee (clarified butter). Nut-free kitchen.

items.name: Medu Vada (3 pcs with Sambar)
items.description: Crispy savory fried lentil doughnuts seasoned with cracked black pepper, curry leaves, and ginger.
items.allergen_notes: Tempered with mustard seeds in sambar broth. 100% Gluten-free.

items.name: Royal South Indian Thali
items.description: Traditional feast platter with 8 curries, sambar, rasam, curd, poori, rice, and payasam dessert.
items.allergen_notes: Poori contains wheat gluten; curd and payasam contain dairy milk.
